from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one document from the collection, capturing its identity and outgoing reference relationships."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper/document as it appears in the text")
    references_in_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that this document explicitly references/cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Output container for the parsing of a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
